author: notCVE
text: Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-03: CVE-2026-119977, WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition (unauthenticated upgrade-window staged-installer RCE, 4.7.0-7.1.3). CVSS 8.1.

author: OminouslyPie
text: Nikke CDN supply chain attack: a GitHub gist documents how the malicious update works and what affected users should do.

author: Crypto3cats
text: Chainstack, a node and RPC provider many Web3 devs build on, disclosed a breach via a third-party component; attacker had 5 days inside. Customer names, emails and password hashes may be exposed.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: actively exploited unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 10.0) in Node-RED on Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced devices.

author: D3bytes
text: A PDF Reader MCP server had an authentication bypass: it read MCP_API_KEY but never validated it, so unauthenticated clients could access the MCP endpoint. CVE-2026-62264.

author: jondot
text: Copilot in Visual Studio could be tricked into editing its own .mcp.json via a trailing dot ('.mcp.json.'), launching a new MCP server. CVE-2026-103572, fixed in October.

author: cubillas888
text: MCPHub: a non-admin could register a server that forwarded other callers' Authorization and cookie headers to an attacker's URL. Fixed in 1.1.8; CVE-2026-120323. Upgrade and rotate tokens if exposed.

author: theagenticdaily
text: AWS Serverless MCP Server path traversal (CVE-2026-116635) before 0.2.1 let write operations read or write JSON files outside the intended folder.

author: agentprime_io
text: Ivanti Connect Secure predictable filenames flaw CVE-2026-118527 actively exploited. Fix: 25.1.1.3, 22.8R2.6.

author: OneSignalDesk
text: Drupal Commerce Core access bypass CVE-2026-118539 actively exploited; fixed in 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: AGTPinsights
text: Playwright 1.64.1 ships a vulnerable Chromium; warning for people running AI coding agents with no containers.

author: Hesamation
text: Binance details the $6.34B hack: in June an engineer searching for a popular AI coding tool downloaded a malicious Homebrew installer; campaign escalated via fake job interviews and internal AI tooling.

author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days (CVE-2026-88771, CVE-2026-88772, CVSS 9.5) actively exploited in attacks, shellcode placed directly into memory.

author: kryll_ai
text: GitBook, docs platform used by many crypto projects, hit by AI-assisted (AI agent) breach. Users urged to rotate integration tokens, Git Sync secrets and API keys.

author: Michaelzsguo
text: Binance published RFO/RCA on the Oct 29 cyberattack ($6.34B stolen): tampered developer tool and fake job interview, then compromised laptops and internal AI tooling.

author: robot2trade1
text: Binance initial findings: months-long campaign; in June a Wallet DevOps engineer downloaded a tampered Homebrew installer while seeking an AI coding tool.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM zero-day CVE-2026-94127 actively exploited, unauthenticated RCE in OAuth, 14,700+ instances exposed, added to CISA KEV.

author: morphisec
text: CISA: ransomware gangs now exploiting critical JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass CVE-2026-63077; KEV updated.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: Hackers use ARTEX AI tool to automate enterprise attacks at machine speed: stolen credentials to cloud privilege escalation, lateral movement and data theft in minutes.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking becoming a full-scale criminal business: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant found criminals hijacking cloud AI access with stolen keys and reselling it.

author: CalatheaAI
text: Google Cloud report: attackers hijack companies' AI model access with stolen cloud keys and resell it; charges at some victims reached $1M; one attacker made 500,000+ LLM API calls.

author: TonTraderCom
text: Hackers ran $100K of AI services with stolen API keys; at least nine developer platforms targeted in October, abusing OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock credentials.

author: swif_ai
text: Glow Labs: coding agents set up archived MCP servers recalled from training data; their 4 high-severity flaws, incl. a prompt-injection RCE, won't be fixed.

author: HarshaHegde0
text: Glow Labs found coding agents installing archived MCP servers from training memory (98% of deprecated installs); puppeteer MCP has RCE via prompt injection, no patch, 17.3M npm downloads.

author: HacktronAI
text: AI found a critical vulnerability missed by multiple audits in 10 minutes: Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso, CVE-2025-5086.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to its cPGuard update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script Nov 2; update to 5.88.25+, rotate DB and cloud keys.

author: undercode_news
text: Amadeus airline distribution platform breach exposes passenger records across multiple airlines through stolen credentials.

author: TPSaaS_io
text: SOCRadar: actor n0n spent over $7,216 on AI services; every documented compromise relied on weak or stolen credentials.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-58115 (CVSS 10.0) Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 exploited via malicious Node-RED flows to plant Linux bots and HTTP exec backdoors.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to actively exploited critical RCE CVE-2026-97229; attackers could steal credentials and compromise supply chains.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 CVSS 10.0: unauthenticated RCE via malicious regex in CI/CD config, actively exploited.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Actively exploited Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 enable privilege escalation.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS CVE-2026-76418: unauthenticated remote attacker can force reload when SSL VPN reachable.

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild, root-level access via missing initialization flaw.

author: iamspiggle
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) TCP/MPTCP use-after-free; unauthenticated remote root demonstrated via automated exploits.

author: cybersec24h
text: Drupal Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 actively exploited; fraudulent $0.01 orders; fixed in 3.3.13 and 8.x-2.41.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Node.js October 2026 updates fix 10 flaws incl. actively exploited critical Node2Shell Brotli flaw; removes trust in eight compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs.

author: joshmanders
text: Platform incident writeup: attackers pulled credentials from inside an app container to request every secret on the platform, and tried the cloud metadata endpoint.

author: BytesNora
text: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks (CVE-2026-111357 actively exploited).

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato botnet installs the Hermes AI agent on hijacked Docker hosts: a worm-like botnet actively scans for Docker daemons with unauthenticated APIs exposed on port 2375, then launches a privileged container and deploys an AI agent on the compromised host.
